hero.briefRole: Anchors landing beat 2 (Sacral) — what the hour feels like, in a real room.

backgrounds.briefRole: brief.md §12 — one of the selectable page backgrounds; carries the dark plum world without competing with content.

placeholders.subject: Cupped hands around a glowing orb on near-black.
placeholders.briefRole: brief.md §2 — RESERVE ONLY. Commissioned, not stock, but it is the single most-reproduced composition in this category and reads as stock. Never a hero or a beat anchor; small inline detail at most.

brandGuides.note: Not a PDF, so no vision extraction needed — machine-readable already. Authoritative record of the artwork's eleven sampled colours WITH computed contrast ratios. See colors below.

colors.source: assets/brand/README.md — sampled from the supplied artwork's own gradient and ground. FACTS about the artwork, not role assignments.

measuredContrast.note: Computed, not estimated. Re-measure before trusting any derived claim. This is the constraint that bit prior versions of this project: the mid-gradient stops are unusable as text on light grounds and the failure is invisible to anyone who already knows what the text says.

derivedOption.#8A6A22 on light grounds: 4.61:1 — a gold that clears AA body on light. Derived, not present in the artwork; optional.
